info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Branch Currency Distribution By Distribution Id-spec
info.description: The Branch Currency Distribution Retrieval API allows users to obtain detailed currency distribution information for a specified branch using its distribution ID. This API serves Banking and Financial service applications, enabling them to track and analyze currency availability across different branches. Typical consumers include banking application developers and financial analysts who require accurate currency distribution data for operational reporting and decision-making. The endpoint supports efficient query mechanisms, ensuring timely access to crucial financial data.

get.summary: Retrieve currency distribution details for a specific branch.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed currency distribution information for the branch identified by RES-100045. Utilizing this data will assist in understanding the currency allocations and distributions specific to that branch.
